# A book kept in CAD that also holds the top-level accounts GnuCash makes for
# itself.
#
# GnuCash's scrub completes a transaction whose splits do not add up by parking
# the difference in `Imbalance-<CUR>`, and puts a split whose account has gone
# in `Orphan-<CUR>` — one of each per currency it met, as children of the root.
# A book kept in CAD that once met a USD transaction GnuCash had to complete
# therefore holds a top-level account in USD that no ledger opened.
#
# What this fixture produces: five top-level accounts a ledger opened, all in
# CAD, and three GnuCash's own — one of them in US dollars. The book is kept in
# CAD, and the accounts GnuCash made say nothing about that.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Imbalance-CAD
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Imbalance-USD
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Orphan-USD
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-05 * "Opening the bank"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -1000.00 CAD
